name: 38460-offloadchurn-qwen25-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1). Host DRAM is part of the allocation: the 8 GiB KV tier is pinned pages in this node's own memory.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine, one node.
architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 28 layers, 28 query heads, 4 key/value heads, head_dim 128, hidden 3584, intermediate 18944, vocab 152064, bf16; ~15.2 GiB of weights, uniform full attention (use_sliding_window false).
workload: offload churn. 32 unique 2048-token prefixes, each followed by 256 unique prompt tokens, generating 64 tokens, bounded at 1280 requests (40 passes over the prefix set), greedy sampling and a static seed of 38460. In guidellm this is `synthetic_text` with one prefix bucket (prefix_count 32, prefix_tokens 2048) cycled by a `concurrent` profile, driving the engine in-process through the `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A research-document assistant on one GPU, serving eight concurrent readers short questions over thirty-two shared 2048-token documents.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Nothing here is tuned. Flat `key: value` only -- the config reader is
# line-based and skips indented lines, so a structured value must stay on ONE line or the key is
# dropped and the engine starts silently without it.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
block-size: 16

# The host-memory KV tier: `CPUOffloadingSpec` is pinned host memory in-process, no secondary
# fs/object tier and no router. 8 GiB = 9,362 offloaded blocks at 896 KiB each. KEEP ON ONE LINE.
kv-transfer-config: {"kv_connector":"OffloadingConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"spec_name":"CPUOffloadingSpec","cpu_bytes_to_use":8589934592}}

# 2 GiB = 2,340 blocks of GPU KV, pinned rather than left to gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9 of an
# 80 GiB card less ~15.2 GiB of weights would give a pool larger than the whole reusable corpus.
kv-cache-memory-bytes: 2147483648

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 32
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
